name: Vlad Vasile-Voiculescu - § 19 - Am 2
title: REPORT on the implementation of Europe’s Beating Cancer Plan
part_text: 19. Stresses that, despite considerable progress, smoking prevalence in the EU remains high, particularly among young people; notes that the interim objective of Europe’s Beating Cancer Plan to achieve a reduction of 30 % in tobacco use by 2025 as compared with 2010 has not yet been met38 ; underlines that the WHO European Region records the highest levels of tobacco consumption globally39 and is projected to remain among the worst-performing regions in the coming years; urges Member States to undertake concrete measures to reduce smoking through evidence-based strategies, including by taking into account that different nicotine products may have differentiated risk profiles, with clear and realistic timelines, with particular attention to preventing youth uptake; \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_ 38 https://www.who.int/europe/news-room/fact-sheets/item/tobacco. 39 https://www.who.int/europe/news/item/08-10-2025-who-european-region-has-the-highest-rate-of-tobacco-use-in-the-world--with-an-alarming-rise-in-young-people-using-e-cigarettes--global-report-warns.
